transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, I'm Liam. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Liam. I joined S-Net mobile last week and I'm trying to bring my old number across, but it still hasn't moved and people can't reach me. It's quite stressful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry, Dmitri, not being reachable is stressful. Can I take your PIN to look into it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. So you joined last week and your old number still hasn't transferred, so people can't reach you. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, sorry. I can see the request.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. So, the transfer is with the porting team. That's the porting team, not me. You'll have to wait for them to call you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: They usually call within five working days.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Five days? I need my number now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand. They'll be in touch. Anything else?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Dmitri. Have a good day.
